name: save-boot-11d-battle-command-rows
description: #110 attempt 2: the command cursor rows of slots 2 and 1, and the slot values themselves. From "stats-battle" (party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; a random battle in md1_1; 11c saw Tifa's menu open first, then Barret's): wait until the widget id reads 1 (open_wait); the menu slot must read 2 within a frame. 30 frames with no input; slot 2's row must read 0 within a frame, Down every 20 frames (held 4) until it reads 1 (r2_down), Up the same way until it reads 0 (r2_up). Take Attack on the default target (Circle every 30 frames until the widget id reads 0, 20 frames, Circle every 30 frames until it reads 0xffff: closed_wait). Wait until it reads 1 again (next_wait); the slot must read 1 within a frame; 30 frames; slot 1's row must read 0 within a frame, Down every 20 frames until it reads 1 (r1_down). Any timeout fails. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.

widget.description: g_BattleMenuModalWidgetId (s16 as u16; config/symbols.battle.txt 0x800F3896; src/battle/battle3.c): the battle menu widget taking input. -1 (0xffff) none (BattleMenuInit), 1 the command menu (Cancel from a sub-menu returns to 1), 0 target selection (BattleMenuUpdate runs the targeting code when it reads 0), 3/7/0x18/0x1A/0x1B sub-menus.
